verdict.rationale: A direct probe shows a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable at https://docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). Machine-readable docs via llms.txt and .md pages back this up for AI-native consumption. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec and its versioning, and evidence that it covers every API surface (Agent, Search, Embeddings).
